messages:
sam_cs: Kicking off onboarding for Vellumx. Pilot target: 3-week run to validate SSO, exports, and cost delta vs current vendor. Quick sync to assign owners and risks.

tess_impl: I can own integration and data contract. Need to know whether they want daily CSV or event streaming.

rahul_eng: From infra side I'll own perf testing and staging prep. Heads up: they use ~5k token sequences for document synthesis in some flows. We should plan model-config tests.

maya_pm: Success criteria from product: (1) SSO working with 2 IdPs, (2) daily exports to BigQuery schema validated, (3) median request latency <250ms for chat, p95 <2s for embeddings, (4) demonstration of cost per 10k tokens at or below target.

oliver_revops: Renewal note: finance cares about predictable unit costs and export access for cost reconciliation. I'll prepare a cost-sample doc for their CFO.

sam_cs: Proposed owners: Sam = CS lead, Tess = integration, Rahul = eng perf, Maya = PM/customer liaison, Oliver = finance/renewal. Ok?

tess_impl: fine. I'll also draft an anonymization script for prompt samples and request sample rows from Vellumx.

rahul_eng: I'll spin up a staging worker and run two 24h passes: interactive and batch. Need sample traffic shape from Maya. Also will include A/B test for quantized vs full precision models.

maya_pm: Sending traffic profile in DM. Vellumx asked that we redact PII; we'll share sanitized prompts by EOD.

reminder-bot: Meeting created: "Vellumx Internal Onboard Prep" Friday 10:30am PT. Invite sent.

oliver_revops: Immediate actions: 1) Tess: draft data contract + export schema (EOD). 2) Rahul: perf plan + staging route (tomorrow). 3) Maya: traffic + anonymized prompt set (EOD). 4) Sam: ask customer for IdP metadata and finance contact. 5) Oliver: draft renewal one-pager.

sam_cs: Thanks team 389 I'll coordinate customer asks and confirm before the prep meeting.

rahul_eng: One technical flag: if prompt lengths spike >8k tokens, memory and latency will need special configs. Tagging a follow-up with Optimize/Runtime.

tess_impl: Noted. Adding model-variant evaluation item to the Confluence checklist.

sam_cs: Great work. We'll reconvene after folks complete their items. :+1:
